title: Father Knows Best
paragraphs: A family situation comedy about Jim and Margaret Anderson and their children, using everyday household problems and generational misunderstandings for warm comedy.

Family situation comedy centered on Jim and Margaret Anderson and children Betty, Bud and Kathy. Frozen GRH snapshot includes the 1948 audition plus 150 dated series recordings through March 25, 1954.

GRH documents the program through Audition (December 20, 1948 to December 20, 1948), Audition (December 20, 1948 to December 20, 1948), NBC sponsored weekly run (August 25, 1949 to May 21, 1953) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and NBC early family cast (August 25, 1949 to July 5, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Bill Forman (announcer on 58 recordings, narrator on 1 recording, and performer on 1 recording), [[person|robert-young|Robert Young]] (performer on 60 recordings), Ed James (creator on 46 recordings, writer on 20 recordings, and performer on 1 recording), Rhoda Williams (performer on 53 recordings), Ted Donaldson (performer on 52 recordings), Norma Jean Nilsson (performer on 47 recordings), and Jean VanderPyl (performer on 46 recordings).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include parenting and household authority, family relationships, home maintenance and domestic projects, household money and allowance, holidays and family celebrations, and teen dating and courtship.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Radio-to-television transition, Postwar suburban family sitcom, Robert Young good-driver campaign, and Consumer household culture.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (24 shared credited people), [[show|the-railroad-hour|The Railroad Hour]] (22 shared credited people), [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (17 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (16 shared credited people), and [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (15 shared credited people).
